title: eviction-aware-launch-scheduler-for-overlapped-comm-and-kv-prefetch
author: Evan Zhang
description: Motivation: Multi-GPU tensor-parallel workloads observed tail latency spikes when NCCL collectives contended with kernel launches and KV cache eviction/prefetch activity. This PR introduces an eviction-aware launch scheduler that coordinates kernel launches with the NCCL progress threads and KV cache prefetch/eviction signals to increase overlap and reduce stalls. Design: 1) Introduce a lightweight launch coordinator that tracks outstanding collective windows and delays non-critical kernel launches until a safe interleaving point; 2) Add a KV cache eviction hint API used by the runtime to mark soon-to-be-evicted KV ranges so prefetch can be prioritized before large collectives; 3) Extend the communication scheduler to stagger stream priorities and use a small local crediting mechanism to avoid single-stream saturation at the NIC/NCCL layer; 4) Add dynamic kernel batching window adjustment to expand batching when collectives are imminent and shrink when latency SLOs are tight. Implementation notes: Changes touch runtime/comm, runtime/scheduler, runtime/kvcache, and tests. New unit and integration tests validate ordering constraints and ensure no deadlocks. Microbenchmarks: On 8xA100 TP-16 experiments with seq_len=2048 and batch=4, end-to-end p99 latency improved 32% (from 278ms to 190ms) and throughput increased 12% under load. Tail KV eviction stalls decreased by ~60% in trace-driven replay. Rollout: feature-flag guarded, gated behind a runtime config (scheduler.eviction_aware=true). Checklist: implement coordinator, add KV hint API, update NCCL stream priority heuristics, add tests, add perf harness and dashboards, document feature in runtime/README. Related: addresses ENG-8843 and is complementary to earlier NCCL-throttler work.

review_comments: Priya Menon: This aligns with the TP tail lat goals. Two asks: ensure the coordinator doesn't add measurable overhead on small single-GPU runs; add a metric for 'coordination_delay_ms' and expose it in the console.

Evan Zhang: Added coordination_delay_ms and added a fast-path that bypasses the coordinator for single-GPU / non-collective-only traces. Microbenchmarks show <0.5% overhead on single-GPU microbenchmarks.
Carlos Rivera: Request change: the KV hint API surface should accept opaque tokens instead of raw KV ranges to allow more flexible eviction strategies downstream.
Evan Zhang: Updated API to accept token handle and added mapping layer in kv_prefetcher. Left the old helper for backwards compatibility for one release.
Aisha Kumari: Could we add an opt-in telemetry event for cases where we delay a launch for >10ms? That will help debugging in prod.
Evan Zhang: Added telemetry event 'launch_delay_exceeded' and a sampling policy. Will watch during canary.
Priya Menon: Approving after CI flakes were resolved and perf dashboard linked.
Carlos Rivera: Approved. Verified p99 improvements on our internal 8x A100 job.
Release Manager: Merging after canary passed. Merge method: squash.
release_notes: Introduce eviction-aware launch scheduler to improve overlap of NCCL collectives and kernel launches, add KV eviction hint API, staggered stream priorities, and dynamic batching window adjustments. Expected benefits: reduced p99 tail latency for multi-GPU TP workloads and fewer KV-eviction stalls. Feature behind runtime.scheduler.eviction_aware toggle.
perf_notes: 8xA100 TP-16, seq_len=2048, batch=4: p99 latency down 32%, throughput +12%, KV eviction stall events -60% in trace replay. Measured via perf/harnesss/tp_trace_replay.yaml and dashboard link: internal/perf/52678
